name: Labour Party
description: Governing party led by Prime Minister Andy Burnham since July 2026. Focuses on building a National Care Service, regional devolution, long-term public service reform, and public oversight of water and energy.

name: Conservative and Unionist Party
description: The official opposition party, advocating for lower taxation, reduced state expenditure, a firm stance on cultural and constitutional institutions, regulatory rollback, and tighter borders.

name: Reform UK
description: Right-wing populist party emphasizing immediate reduction in non-essential immigration, freezing net migration, leaving the ECHR, scrapping Net Zero subsidies, cutting public sector waste, and raising personal tax allowances.

name: Liberal Democrats
description: Third largest party in Parliament, prioritizing NHS and social care reform, sewage prevention in UK waterways, proportional representation electoral reform, closer cooperation with the EU, and green transition.

name: Green Party of England and Wales
description: Progressive environmentalist party advocating for a wealth tax on multi-millionaires, full public ownership of utilities, rapid cessation of fossil fuels, universal basic services, and major investment in social housing.

name: Scottish National Party
description: Scottish nationalist and social-democratic party advocating for Scottish independence within the EU, progressive taxation, an end to UK austerity, and universal benefits protection.

name: Plaid Cymru
description: Welsh nationalist, social-democratic party campaigning for Welsh independence, fair funding formulas (replacing the Barnett formula), green regional infrastructure, and protection of the Welsh language.

name: Restore Britain
motto: Restoring Heritage, Sovereignty and Free Enterprise
description: Emerging political pressure party advocating for restoring traditional British civil liberties, constitutional sovereignty, dismantling quangos, abolishing Net Zero statutes, and reviving regional manufacturing.
